name: Bizfile MCP
description: Company intelligence and sanctions screening across 130+ jurisdictions and 328 global sanctions lists. Free tier: 20 calls/month, no API key required.

tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Search for companies by name across UK Companies House, Singapore ACRA, US SEC EDGAR, and 130+ jurisdictions. Returns registration number, status, address, incorporation date.

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Get full company registry profile including status, registered address, SIC codes, accounts filing dates and confirmation statement status.

tools.name: verify_company
tools.description: KYC-style verification returning confidence rating HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, name match, number match, and active status.

tools.name: check_company_risk
tools.description: AI-powered risk assessment returning score 0-100, risk level LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL, risk factors, and recommended due diligence actions.

tools.name: get_officers
tools.description: Get full directors and officers list including appointment dates, resignation dates, roles, and nationalities. Use for UBO and beneficial ownership checks.

tools.name: screen_entity
tools.description: Screen a person, company, or vessel against 328 global sanctions lists including OFAC SDN, UN Security Council, EU Consolidated, UK OFSI, MAS Singapore, Australia DFAT, Japan METI, Canada SEMA, Switzerland SECO, and 318 more. Returns BLOCK/ENHANCED_DUE_DILIGENCE/PROCEED with trade finance specific guidance. Paid API key required. Cost: 0.15 GBP per check (Pro), 0.125 GBP per check (Enterprise).
